description: This file provides utility functions for exporting DOM content to PNG and PDF formats in a frontend web application. It includes methods to trigger downloads, convert DOM nodes to images, and generate PDFs from DOM content using 'html-to-image' and 'jspdf' libraries.

methods.name: downloadDataUrl(dataUrl, filename)
methods.description: Triggers a browser download for a given data URL and filename by creating a temporary anchor element and simulating a click.

methods.name: exportNodeToPng(node, { filename, pixelRatio = 2 } = {})
methods.description: Converts a DOM node into a PNG image Data URL using 'html-to-image' and optionally triggers a download.

methods.name: exportNodeToPdf( node, { filename = 'certificate.pdf', orientation = 'landscape', pageSize = 'a4', pixelRatio = 2 } = {} )
methods.description: Converts a DOM node into a PNG image, embeds it into a PDF document with 'jspdf', and triggers a download of the generated PDF.
